test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 15 Nov, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Six people, S, T, U, V, W and X, are sitting in a straight row facing north. Only two people sit to the left of U. Only two people sit between U and X. T sits to the immediate right of S. W sits to the immediate left of V. V is not a neighbour of X. Who sits at the extreme left end of the row?
solution:
**Given:** Six people, S, T, U, V, W and X, are sitting in a straight row facing north.

1) Only two people sit to the left of U.

2) Only two people sit between U and X. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a442bee4499488ffea0b68c5b797d47209b6bac659f3e7c9f9b77a1e84c8ca8.png] 

3) W sits to the immediate left of V.

4) V is not a neighbour of X.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/507342c481d67d5ac1eb7614ea1f504aa70338c220145b52526966d613f4c741.png] 

5) T sits to the immediate right of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/588e14bb5c7e84ded5d28fc0ca819647f75c294979aead18e3fe88e3236699be.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, W sits at the extreme left end of the row.

Hence, **"Option 1"** is the correct answer.
